plainName: Tax on short-term gains from listed shares and equity funds
summary: Short-term gains on equity shares, equity-oriented fund units or business-trust units sold with securities transaction tax are taxed at their own flat rate, apart from the rest of the income, which is taxed at slab rates.

routes.name: The flat rate on the gains
routes.description: The gains are taxed at their own rate; the rest of the income at slab rates.

routes.name: Unused basic exemption set against the gains
routes.description: For a resident individual or Hindu undivided family, any part of the basic exemption the rest of the income does not use reduces these gains before they are taxed.

disqualifiers.description: Deductions from gross total income are not allowed against these gains; they are allowed only from the rest of the income.
